partA.description: 2 Questions from each module.  Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks (8x3 =24marks)

partB.description: Each question carries 9 marks. Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered. Each question can have a maximum of 3 sub divisions. (4x9 = 36 marks)

courseOutcomes.description: Explain the layout, components and working of steam, gas, hydro, and nuclear power plants.
Calculate the performance parameters of simple and modified Rankine cycles.
Calculate the performance parameters of steam turbines and steam nozzles.
Explain the working of various energy storage systems
Discuss the economics of power generation and pollution from power plants and their effect on the environment
